title: The Skateboard and the Twelve Year Olds — Part 1

series.summary: Gon, Kurapika, and Leorio run through the endless underground tunnel in the First Phase of the Hunter Exam. A silver-haired boy named Killua joins Gon on a skateboard, sparking an instant friendship and rivalry between the two twelve-year-olds.

segments.voiceover_text: Two hours into the first phase, examiner Satotz leads hundreds of applicants through a pitch-black tunnel with no finish line in sight.
A silver-haired boy named Killua glides alongside on a skateboard. Leorio explodes in fury, shouting that using wheels in an endurance test is blatant cheating.
Gon defends him, pointing out that the examiner only said to follow him. Killua grins, amused by the boy's quick thinking.
Killua asks Gon's age and discovers they are both twelve years old. He kickflips his skateboard into his hand and matches Gon stride for stride, leaving Leorio fuming.
